pages.title: Hustle & Drift in ZIL
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Drive a ZIL truck with a load of cargo and get it to the delivery point in Hustle & Drift in ZIL. The goods have to stay on the truck, even when you throw it into a slide. Drift along the way to increase the cash you earn from the delivery. The challenge is keeping the truck and its load under control while going for that extra money.

pages.title: ENDLESS
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: A monster is coming up the stairs behind you in ENDLESS. Tap or hold Climb to stay ahead, and press Turn when the staircase changes direction. A wrong turn ends the run, and hesitating gives the monster time to catch up. A Magic Flask briefly lets you handle the climb with one button, while a Blue Lantern makes the monster disappear for a while.

pages.title: Roller Coaster: Obby Race
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Drive a minecart along narrow tracks in Roller Coaster: Obby Race. Accelerate where you have room and brake before sharp turns so you can keep the cart on the rails. The courses grow more demanding as the turns and obstacles get harder to judge. Unlock other carts and try different routes to see which stretches you can complete.

pages.title: Pongoal
pages.creator: Vagstech
pages.description: Pongoal turns paddle rallies into a football shootout. Move your paddle to cover your goal and return the ball before it gets past you. To score, you need to send the ball past the opposing paddle and into the other goal. Get back into position after an attack so you can deal with the next return.

pages.title: Cooking Empire
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Take charge of a kitchen in Cooking Empire. Fry, boil, and bake dishes from around the world, then serve them as they're ready. The pace puts pressure on both parts of the job. You need to keep up with the cooking and get finished meals out, so decide what to prepare next while you still have dishes to serve.

pages.title: Super Ninja Balloon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: A ninja star is your tool for clearing balloons in Super Ninja Balloon. Aim each throw at a balloon or group you want to pop, and look for shots that set off a combo. The levels introduce arrangements that take more careful aim. Study where the balloons sit before you throw so you can make progress even when the obvious shot is awkward.

pages.title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY is a paper doll game where you choose Anna's outfits for scenes in her fairy tale. Put together a look for a romantic date or a costume party, then switch styles for occasions like Halloween and Christmas. Each scene gives you a different reason to change what Anna wears and decide which pieces work together.

pages.title: Fly and shoot 1. Italian Bosses
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Choose a character and fly into an 8-bit-style arcade shooter in Fly and shoot 1. Italian Bosses. Fire through enemy groups and take on the boss waiting at the end of each stage. Rescuing Laba earns bonuses along the way. Try a higher difficulty for faster action and more aggressive enemies, which give you less time to react during each flight.

pages.title: Burger Empire
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Run a café that serves burgers and coffee in Burger Empire. Get patties and drinks ready for customers and earn coins from the orders you serve. Put those coins into new tables, booths, and dining areas to grow the business. You can also choose how to arrange the café, what décor goes in it, and which special items make it onto the menu.

pages.title: Bubble Sorting Infinite Remastered
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Move bubbles from tube to tube in Bubble Sorting Infinite Remastered. Group bubbles of one color so they pop and free up room for the colors still mixed together. Groups range from three to ten bubbles. Think about which tube will have space after each move, especially when a bubble you need is trapped beneath another color.

pages.title: Thread Match
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Sort thread by color to build embroidery patterns in Thread Match. The colors are arranged in layers, so some of the threads you need appear only after you work through the ones on top. Decide which part of the palette to uncover next and keep track of the moves you have left as you work toward completing the pattern.

pages.title: Stickman Doors and Island
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Help Stick get out of two different traps in Stickman Doors and Island. In one story a criminal locks him inside a series of rooms, and in the other he finds himself stranded at sea on an island. Look for objects you can use, solve the puzzles blocking the way, and figure out how to open each door or get past the next obstacle.

pages.title: PIZZA PUZZLE
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Fit slices together to complete pizzas in PIZZA PUZZLE. Place pieces so matching parts sit next to each other and join up. Each placement affects how much room you have for the pieces that come after it. Keep an eye on open spaces while you build, because the game ends when there is nowhere left to put a piece.

pages.title: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly
pages.creator: Iamgronig
pages.description: An alien invasion interrupts your superhero's vacation in Alien Chase - Swing and Fly. Grapple between skyscrapers to stay out of reach of the swarm pursuing you. Keep the swings going from one building to the next and judge when to make the next connection. The escape continues for as long as you can stay ahead of the aliens.

pages.title: Capybara Go!
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Assemble a capybara army and send it into battle in Capybara Go! Look at what your capybaras do well and position them so their strengths help against the opposing force. The way you set up the group is part of the strategy. When you face stronger enemies, think through the lineup before committing your army to the fight.

pages.title: Room Sort Floor Plan
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Piece together rooms from above in Room Sort Floor Plan. Move the sections of the layout until they fit into a home, treating each floor plan like a jigsaw puzzle. Compare the shape and position of the rooms to decide where they belong. Each level gives you another layout to organize and a different arrangement to work out.

pages.title: Planet Hopper
pages.creator: Purple Ghost Games
pages.description: Guide a ship from planet to planet in Planet Hopper. Aim for the next world before leaving the one you're on and judge the direction of each jump carefully. A bad trajectory can send your ship drifting into open space. Keep finding reachable planets and chaining those jumps together as you make your way farther through the galaxy.

pages.title: 100 Doors Puzzle Box
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Work your way up a building one locked room at a time in 100 Doors Puzzle Box. Search each room for hidden objects and clues, then figure out how the things you find can help open the door. Once you solve a room, the elevator takes you to the next floor. There are 100 doors to work through.

pages.title: SUIKA WATERMELON DROP
pages.creator: POKET GEAR
pages.description: Drop fruit into a box and build your way up to a watermelon in SUIKA WATERMELON DROP. Drag a fruit to line it up before releasing it. When two of the same kind touch, they merge into a different fruit. Try to leave matching fruit close together and keep space above the pile so pieces don't spill out.

pages.title: Motor Tour
pages.creator: Wolves Interactive
pages.description: Take a motorcycle through traffic in Motor Tour. Race other riders, see how far you can go in endless mode, or aim for close passes as you weave between vehicles. On the keyboard, use WASD to drive and brake, and Shift to use nitro. Earn cash from your rides and use it to upgrade your bike.

pages.title: Pet Fall
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Slide the animal blocks sideways in Pet Fall and fill a whole horizontal row to clear it. Caged pets stay put, while frozen ones need to be freed twice. Look for spaces you can slide the other pets into so a stubborn block doesn't leave a permanent gap. There are bonuses to help when you get stuck.

pages.title: Aqua Blitz 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pearl the mermaid guides you through the underwater gem puzzles in Aqua Blitz 2. Make groups of matching gems and work through increasingly complicated boards as you go. After a match, look over the new arrangement for gems you can line up next. Pearl introduces the tricks of the game as you progress through its hundreds of stages.

pages.title: Fidget Toys Pop It
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Press the bubbles on shaped sensory toys in Fidget Toys Pop It. Click with a mouse or tap the screen to work through puzzles built around the toys and hear the sounds they make. Try shapes such as a dinosaur, a cactus, a heart, and a flower as you move from one toy to another.

pages.title: VEX 3 Xmas
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Jump and run through snowy trap courses in VEX 3 Xmas. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move past the candy canes, Christmas trees, and obstacles on your route. When you stop, you can use the mouse to look ahead before making your next move. Reach the end of each zone to move on, and watch your step even in the level menu.

pages.title: Match Mart
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Clear shelves by putting three identical products together in Match Mart. Drag an item to a shelf with room for it, and plan around what you can see at the front. When you clear the front goods, the products behind them move forward. Leave a free spot where you can use it to set up the next group.

pages.title: Madness Combat - The Sheriff Clones
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Fight your way through a complex full of Grunts in Madness Combat - The Sheriff Clones. Pick up weapons you find and take down the Sheriff Clones, then escape before Tricky the Clown reaches you. Move with WASD, use the left mouse button to fire, and right-click to dodge. Press C or the middle mouse button to collect a weapon.

pages.title: Escape Run
pages.creator: Advergame Technologies Private Limited
pages.description: Help a mountain man get away from the media in Escape Run. Run through the cold, avoiding the obstacles in his path, and pick up fruit when you can reach it safely. Fruit pays for power-ups that can help with the escape. Watch the route ahead so you can decide when to go for a pickup and when to focus on getting past an obstacle.

pages.title: Checkers RPG: Online PvP Battle
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose a hero for a real-time match against another player in Checkers RPG: Online PvP Battle. The game puts hero selection and skill upgrades alongside the moves of a checkers match. Click a character on the board, then choose the square to move to. Think through the move before you commit and build up the skills of the hero you want to use.

pages.title: Monster Dash
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Lead the monsters to the finish in Monster Dash, a 50-level obstacle game. Tap or click to move through courses lined with traps. Watch how the danger sits along the path before you try to get the monsters across it. Some stretches call for patience, so wait for an opening and take each obstacle in turn.

pages.title: Merge Master
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Combine warriors or dinosaurs before sending them into battle in Merge Master. Build your side to take on enemies such as dragons and other dinosaurs, then attack to seize their position. The fights play out in real time, so decide quickly which units to merge. Tougher opponents stand between your army and the final boss.

pages.title: The Last Man
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Find an escape route through a dark facility full of aliens in The Last Man. Search from a top-down view for weapons and equipment, and pick up what helps you survive. Use the map to get your bearings and switch on night vision or thermal goggles when you need them. An alien can kill you in one hit, so keep watching for threats as you move.

pages.title: Stack Builder - Skyscraper
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Build a tower by dropping one section at a time in Stack Builder - Skyscraper. Tap or click to release the current section when it lines up with the one below. Each new piece becomes the landing surface for the next one. Keep your timing steady as the tower rises and see how high you can build it.

pages.title: Elon Cars : Online Sky Stunt
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Join a room for up to five drivers in Elon Cars : Online Sky Stunt. Everyone begins in the same car. Drive across the map to change vehicles and raise your level, trying to get through the upgrades before the other players. It costs 50 Elon Coins to enter a room, and the arrow keys control your car.

pages.title: Zombie Last Castle 5
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Hold off 12 waves of zombies at a desert castle in Zombie Last Castle 5. Use weapons and traps to keep the attackers away from the building. An automatic gun on the roof helps cover the approach, and you can upgrade it as you prepare for stronger groups. Defend the castle alone or share the fight with up to three other players.

pages.title: Funny Shooter
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Survive an invasion of enemies with different sizes and attacks in Funny Shooter. Move out of the way of grenades and stay clear of opponents carrying pitchforks, axes, or chainsaws. Choose from 18 weapons, including pistols, machine guns, and launchers. Use the mouse to look and fire, and switch weapons as the fight calls for a different approach.

pages.title: SEQUENCES
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Work out what comes next in SEQUENCES. Look at the order of the items already shown and compare the available answers. Click the choice that fits the pattern to complete the sequence. Focus on how one position relates to the next so you can spot the rule even when several of the choices look plausible.

pages.title: Arkadium's Codeword
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Decode a letter grid in Arkadium's Codeword. A number stands for the same letter everywhere it appears, and a few letters are filled in to get you started. Use those clues to work out what the partial words could be. Select a cell and enter a letter by typing it or clicking it, then use the number's other appearances to check your deduction.

pages.title: Cashier 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Work a supermarket register in Cashier 3D and give each customer the right change. Check the price and the money the customer hands you, then calculate the difference and pick the cash that adds up to it. The job calls for speed as well as accuracy. Keep track of what you've counted so you can finish each transaction promptly.

pages.title: The Final Earth 2
pages.creator: Florian van Strien
pages.description: Build a vertical space colony in The Final Earth 2 after Earth is destroyed. Start with an exploration ship on a tiny world and gather the resources to put up your first buildings. Research better technology as your settlement grows, while making sure people have homes, food, and places to spend their free time. See how far you can develop the colony into a metropolis.

pages.title: Shopping Mall Tycoon
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Start with a small plot and one shop in Shopping Mall Tycoon. Manage the store and use the money you earn to expand. Each investment takes you a step closer to running a larger shopping business. Decide when you have enough money to put into the next part of the mall and build up from that first location.

pages.title: Baby Taylor Farm Tour Caring Animals
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Visit Uncle James's farm with Taylor and her dad in Baby Taylor Farm Tour Caring Animals. Meet the animals on the farm, including pigs, sheep, ducks, and turkeys. Uncle James shows Taylor how to look after them, and you help her with their care. Follow along as she learns what to do with animals she's seeing for the first time.

pages.title: Nerd Quiz
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find your nerd percentage in Nerd Quiz by answering questions about fandoms and internet culture. The topics range from Marvel, Harry Potter, and Game of Thrones to Comic Con, Reddit, and Twitch. See how your knowledge carries across those different subjects and check the percentage the quiz gives you at the end.

pages.title: Princess Puppy Caring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Rescue an injured puppy after its hut catches fire in Princess Puppy Caring. Use the fire engine at the hut, then turn your attention to treating the puppy. Once you've dealt with the emergency and cared for the animal, choose an outfit for the princess to finish the story.

pages.title: Mr Jack vs Zombies
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take down zombies one shot at a time in Mr Jack vs Zombies. Tap to fire, but take a moment to check the layout before you shoot. Each stage plays out as a physics puzzle, so where you aim matters as much as pulling the trigger. Look for a shot that can reach the zombies you're trying to clear.

pages.title: Fantasy Helix
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Get a bouncing ball to the bottom of a spiral tower in Fantasy Helix. Work your way through the gaps and keep the ball off the colored tiles as it falls. Check which parts of the next platform are safe before trying to descend. The spooky maze is cleared when the ball makes it all the way down.

pages.title: Pig Adventure Game 2D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Guide a pig through side-scrolling stages in Pig Adventure Game 2D. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to jump. Watch for traps and enemies as you look for a safe way forward, and pick up coins you can reach along the way. Take care around cannons and time your jumps across the hazards.

pages.title: Easter Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild Easter pictures from scattered pieces in Easter Puzzle. Pick one of six images and choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece puzzle. Look for pieces that share an edge or part of the picture and fit them into place. You can return to the same image with more pieces when you want a harder version of it.

pages.title: Ball Run
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Guide a ball along a course with color-changing sections in Ball Run. Use the left mouse button to control the ball and pay attention when its color changes. Check the colors of the blocks ahead as you move through the course. Making it farther depends on watching those colors as well as the ball's position.

pages.title: Jewel Blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag jewel shapes onto the board in Jewel Blocks Puzzle. Fit the pieces into open spaces to complete rows or columns and clear them. A piece that fills a gap in one direction can also help you finish a line in the other. Look at the available pieces and make room before the board becomes crowded.

pages.title: Candy Riddles: Free Match 3 Puzzle
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Match cookies, ice cream, cupcakes, and other sweets in Candy Riddles: Free Match 3 Puzzle. Bring three matching treats together and look for combinations that help you through the harder stages. Different boards give you new groups of sweets to work with, and you can collect prizes as you make your way through the levels.

pages.title: Xmas Downhill
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Head down a winter course in Xmas Downhill. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer around obstacles while picking up coins along the way. Check where the next hazard sits before moving across the slope. Spend the coins you collect to unlock other looks for your character and new environments to descend through.

pages.title: Stick The Dots
pages.creator: Thumb Game Studio
pages.description: Click to launch dots toward their matching targets in Stick The Dots. Watch the position of the target and choose when to release each dot. The shot has to stick to the right place, and a miss ends the attempt. Get the timing right through one pattern before moving on to the next level.

pages.title: Offroad Passenger Bus Simulator : City Coach Simulator
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive a city coach through traffic in Offroad Passenger Bus Simulator : City Coach Simulator. Pick up riders and get them to their destinations safely. The size of the bus matters when you maneuver through the streets, so leave space around cars and watch for pedestrians crossing ahead as you make your way to the next stop.

pages.title: Connect The Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Draw paths between matching Halloween characters in Connect The Halloween. Click or tap a character, then drag toward the other one in the pair. Look over the board before drawing a route so you can see where other pairs need to go. Work through the layout until you've joined the matching characters.

pages.title: Frontline Army Commando War
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take part in military assault missions as a member of the commando squad in Frontline Army Commando War. Move with WASD and use the mouse to fire as you engage enemies on the battlefield. Space lets you jump and Shift lets you run, so you can switch between moving quickly and lining up a shot.

pages.title: Happy Halloween Match 3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line up groups of matching pieces on a Halloween board in Happy Halloween Match 3. Use the mouse to make matches and watch how the arrangement changes after each move. Look for three matching pieces close enough to line up, then check the area you just cleared for a chance to make another match.

pages.title: American Touchdown
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Carry the ball toward the end zone in American Touchdown, or throw it to keep the play going. Score touchdowns on your own or share the keyboard with a friend in two-player mode. The first player uses A and D to move and W to throw. The second player moves with the left and right arrows and throws with the up arrow.

pages.title: BottleFlip3D
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Get a bottle from the start of the course to the finish in BottleFlip3D. Click to make the bottle jump and time each flip so it lands where you need it for the next one. Look at the space ahead before you click. The landing sets up the next jump, so a well-timed flip helps you keep moving toward the end.

pages.title: Married To A Prince
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play as Mia in Married To A Prince, an interactive story that begins at her new high school. There she meets Chance, who turns out to be the crown prince of Vakovia. Choose how Mia responds during each episode. Her decisions shape her relationships and how she gets to know Chance beyond his public role as a prince.

pages.title: EG Air Battles
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Take on enemy planes and fighters in EG Air Battles. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide your aircraft while collecting supplies in flight. Look for fuel, extra lives, ammunition, missiles, and upgrades among the pickups. Grab stars when you can, but keep watching for the enemy aircraft you need to take down.

pages.title: Ellie Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Ellie get ready for the hospital when she goes into labor with twins in Ellie Twins Birth. Give her water while she waits for the ambulance. Once the babies arrive, weigh them and change their diapers before the family goes home. Tap through the story to help with each task in turn.

pages.title: Shoot N Merge
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Fire numbered pieces into stacks in Shoot N Merge. Click to send the next number where you want it, and use matching values to merge pieces into larger ones. Check the stacks before firing so you keep room for later shots. Build up your score as you advance without leaving yourself out of moves.

pages.title: Block it
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Keep the ball bouncing inside its cage in Block it. Tap to bring the paddle into place just as the ball heads toward the opening. Watch the angle of each bounce so you can tell when the paddle will be needed again. If the ball makes it through the opening, your run ends.

pages.title: Knock Balls 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fire a cannon at stacks of blocks in Knock Balls 2. Use the mouse to aim at the structure and send cannonballs into it to knock the blocks down. The number of shots you have is limited, so look for places where one hit can bring down several pieces. Check what is still standing before aiming again.

pages.title: Pool Clash: 8 Ball Billiards Snooker
pages.creator: T-Bull S.A.
pages.description: Line up your cue and adjust the shot angle in Pool Clash: 8 Ball Billiards Snooker. Play online 8-ball matches or try the single-player mode, which has five difficulty levels. Separate challenges give you more shots to work through, and you can select different cues. Use the aiming buttons to make small adjustments before you strike the ball.

pages.title: Space Wing
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Fly through a series of rings in Space Wing. Keep your ship lined up to pass through each ring and raise your score, while firing at enemies that threaten the run. Watch both the route and the enemy positions so you can make it through the next opening and keep the ship going.

pages.title: Sniper Strike
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Use a sniper rifle to take down targets in Sniper Strike. The game has three maps, so you can try the shooting challenge in different locations and see where you score best. Take time to line up each shot before firing and use the high-score system to track how well you did across attempts.

pages.title: Sky Ball
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Steer a rolling ball across raised platforms in Sky Ball. Move left or right to line up with the route, and take boosts to build speed before gaps. Longer jumps can improve your score, but you still need to land on the next platform. Watch for obstacles on the way and keep the ball from falling off.

pages.title: Seesawball 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Tilt a seesaw to roll the ball into your opponent's goal in Seesawball 2. The ball starts in the middle, with a goal at each end of the platform. Use A for the first player and K for the second, or play with touch controls. The first player to get 11 goals wins.

pages.title: Princess Valentines Day Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Pick party outfits for the princesses in Princess Valentines Day Party. Use the mouse to go through the choices and decide on a look for each guest before the Valentine's Day celebration. You can give the princesses different styles for the same party, depending on which pieces you want to put together.

pages.title: EG Road Crossing
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Make your way across successive lanes in EG Road Crossing. Watch for a safe gap before leaving your current lane, then move across before the path closes. Keep checking where you can safely stop and where you need to keep moving. The further you go, the more crossings you have to judge in the same run.

pages.title: Extreme Way
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Run as a ninja in Extreme Way and see how far you can get through the obstacles. Jump past hazards and break through walls in your path. Look ahead to tell which action the next obstacle calls for, then time it without losing your rhythm. Each run gives you a chance to improve your record.

pages.title: Summer lake 1.5
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Catch fish and use the money they earn to upgrade your gear in Summer lake 1.5. The waters hold species such as bluegill, bowfin, northern pike, and snakehead. Buy bait and rods or spend your catch money on new places to fish. There are six locations to explore as you build up your equipment.

pages.title: Finger Driver Neon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Steer through a neon road course in Finger Driver Neon. Turn with the left and right arrow keys on a keyboard, or steer by touch. Watch the road as it bends and collect coins when they're in reach. Spend what you pick up to get different cars for future runs.

pages.title: KrisMas Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear the Christmas tiles before time runs out in KrisMas Mahjong. Select two tiles with the same decoration when they are next to each other or can be joined by a clear path with up to three right-angle turns. Remove pairs to open routes through the board and use those new routes to reach matches that were blocked.

pages.title: Castle Dash
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Run up the tower in Castle Dash and watch for attackers and open doors along the way. Keep an eye on the stretch immediately above you as you climb so you can react before running into trouble. The goal is to get past the hazards and make it to the top of the castle.

pages.title: Street Dance Fashion 2
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two competitors for a street dance event in Street Dance Fashion 2. Start by choosing the first girl's outfit, then put together a look for the second. Think about what each girl should wear for the competition and decide how to style them before they take part in the dance event.

pages.title: Pro Gym
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Follow the arrows to perform workouts in Pro Gym. Click and drag, or use touch, to make the movements shown on screen. Pay attention to the speed and repetition meters while completing each exercise. Check the character's food and sleep meters between tasks. Buy something to eat when the food meter runs low and rest when the sleep meter drops.

pages.title: Road Safety
pages.creator: IP Konstantin Boronenkov
pages.description: Send pedestrians across a busy street in Road Safety. Watch the passing cars and choose a gap that gives people enough time to cross. Moving too early can put someone in the path of a vehicle, so check the traffic before sending the next pedestrian. Get people across safely as you work toward earning stars in each level.

pages.title: Robo Twins
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Get both robots out of each stage in Robo Twins. Watch both routes and time the jumps so each robot gets past the obstacles on its own path. A jump that clears the way for one robot only gets you part of the way through. Keep the other robot in view until both have made it to the end.

pages.title: Bomb It 4
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Drop bombs to clear obstacles and catch opponents in the blast in Bomb It 4. Pick up power-ups to carry extra bombs or increase their reach. Play solo or with a second local player, and choose among modes such as Arcade, Battle Royale, Coin Collector, and Tile Tag. Check your escape route before leaving a bomb behind.

pages.title: Gun Battle
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Face another player in an online shootout in Gun Battle. Wait for the game to find an opponent, then fire at the other gunslinger while watching for return shots. Time your attack so you can land a hit before the other player does. The game shows the outcome when the duel is over.

pages.title: Blondie's Dream Car
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Customize a car and choose an outfit for its driver in Blondie's Dream Car. Change the paint, add stickers, and try different headlamps or side mirrors. Once you're happy with the car, style Blondie for her ride. Try a driving suit or a dress and decide what works with the car you put together.
